summary: Cred and Duck discuss Bitcoin's strong weekly breakout above the 104K range high, maintaining bullish bias as long as this level holds. They express significant concerns about MicroStrategy-style leveraged BTC holding companies, predicting with 90-99% confidence these will eventually implode (similar to GBTC and Luna). ETH is viewed neutrally - holding support on ETH/BTC for the first time in a while, but needing BTC to lead for meaningful upside. Hyperliquid is highlighted as a standout altcoin with proper tokenomics and strong execution. The hosts discuss the lack of traditional altseason dynamics, noting that ETF and leveraged corporate buyers have broken the wealth effect that previously drove altcoin rallies.
key_takeaways: BTC bullish above 104K on weekly close; bearish retests historically fail on high timeframes
MicroStrategy and copycat leveraged BTC companies are the likely source of next cycle's systemic crisis (90-99% confidence of implosion)
ETH/BTC holding support for first time in extended period; 4K target possible on breakout
